title: Random Duo #04 (스테인드글라스+임산부)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Stained Glass): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, silver-white locs cascading to her waist — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, not a garment, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge, never large sheets, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow, never flat. BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, bright light passing through each tiny pane with sharp refraction glints, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

#2 (Pregnant): Turkish, in her late 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, cool ash-brown hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real pores, real living eyes, 5 mixed piercings set with pearls in mixed-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of silver earrings. Painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic, a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle, wide ochre bands curving fully around her belly, the densest concentration of spiral floral bands wrapping the belly as centrepiece and continuing over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, extreme ochre platform stiletto pumps.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 2, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio.
